name: openapi-vec-empty-skip
description: OpenAPI/progenitor: an optional array property generates Vec with skip_serializing_if(is_empty) — an all-probes-failed response omits the key entirely, so JSON consumers indexing body["array"] see null, not []. When an endpoint's array is semantically always-present, mark it required in the spec and have tests create the probed fixtures before asserting the array shape; also force a rebuild (touch) after a spec regen before re-diagnosing a failing test — the first re-run may execute a stale binary and re-emit the old panic text.
